accounting.rationale: Original physical PDF122, printed108, lines4-5; the actual title is Allocatable coarray. It distinguishes declared corank from later established cobounds, without inventing a new allocation event.
The coarray's corank is specified even before allocation. A known property does not authorize an intrinsic whose unallocated-argument conditions are unmet.
Allocation determines cobounds under9.7.1; data shape, allocation count, type parameters and collective image conditions remain separate.

Argument association is another stated route. ALLOCATABLE dummy actuals must have ALLOCATABLE and the same corank under15.5.2.7; do not impose that matching rule on every nonallocatable coarray dummy.
PDF122 line6: one colon is one deferred-coshape-spec.
PDF122 lines7-8: ALLOCATABLE coarrays require the deferred list.
PDF122 line9 gives the exact corank count.
PDF122 lines10-11 separates undefined cobounds from use restrictions and the qualified inquiry exception.
16.1's general permission is subject to each intrinsic's actual requirements; it is not a universal cobound sampler.
PDF122 line12 binds available allocated cobounds to allocation.
PDF122 lines13-14 preserves established cobounds across redefinition or undefinition of expression variables, not arbitrary team/lifetime changes.

requirements.title: A deferred coshape specification is one colon
requirements.definition: Each deferred-coshape-spec is a single colon. R809's list and C827's ALLOCATABLE context determine complete declarations.

pending.colon-admission: PENDING compile admission of ALLOCATABLE INTEGER scalar x[:] and array x(:)[:,:], with distinct ordinary-rank and corank counts.
pending.malformed-colon-spec: PENDING a complete ALLOCATABLE scalar declaration with[::], repaired only to[:]. Require the actual deferred-coshape grammar cause, not disabled coarrays, unrelated shape or EOF recovery.

requirements.oracle: Finite colon grammar/control plans; no allocation or remote effect is inferred from admission.
requirements.oracle_limitation: No unallocated cobound inquiry, compiler-profile substitution or forced fatal diagnostic policy.

requirements.title: ALLOCATABLE coarrays require deferred coshape lists
requirements.definition: An ALLOCATABLE coarray's coarray-spec is a deferred-coshape-spec-list, independently of whether its ordinary data rank is scalar or array.

pending.scalar-explicit-coshape: PENDING ALLOCATABLE scalar INTEGER x[*], repaired only to x[:]. Keep type, rank0, corank1, ALLOCATABLE and otherwise complete context; no initializer or value read.
pending.array-explicit-coshape: PENDING ALLOCATABLE rank-two INTEGER x(:,:)[1:2,*], repaired only to[:,:]. Ordinary deferred shape and corank2 remain fixed; reject an unrelated C834/data-shape error as this cause.
pending.component-owner-source-use: PENDING source relation to the existing C751 component explicit/deferred coshape and ALLOCATABLE controls. Preserve their IDs, roles and inputs; do not clone or re-own component-specific tests.
pending.allocatable-dummy-source-use: PENDING complete ALLOCATABLE dummy coarray context with deferred coshape and actual ALLOCATABLE/same-corank requirements. An unallocated actual is allowed for the proper dummy role but does not make cobounds available.

requirements.oracle: Exact complete-explicit-coshape to deferred-list repair pairs, not malformed mixed syntax or ALLOCATABLE removal.
requirements.oracle_limitation: A missing coarray runtime/configuration or unsupported component feature is not a C827 diagnosis. Compile controls are not multi-image executions.

requirements.title: Deferred-list colon count determines corank
requirements.definition: The corank equals the number of colons in the coarray's deferred-coshape list, not the number of ordinary array dimensions or elements.

pending.scalar-coranks: PENDING genuine configured execution of scalar INTEGER coarrays with one and two deferred colons. Collectively allocate valid coshapes on all participating images, require successful status/ALLOCATED before LCOBOUND, then compare SIZE(LCOBOUND(...)) independently with1/2.
pending.array-rank-independent: PENDING allocated rank-one/rank-two data coarrays with deliberately different coranks2/1 and small constant data extents. Check data rank only on actual data objects and corank through a permitted cobound result size; never substitute RANK for corank.
pending.allocated-dummy-corank: PENDING allocated actual/dummy coarrays with matching corank under15.5.2.7 and complete interfaces. Observe declared colon count with valid allocated-property inquiries; do not use unallocated actuals or an assumed-rank coarray dummy.

requirements.oracle: Independent integer corank expectations after proper collective allocation/association, not a constructor-rank or fixed-destination proxy.
requirements.oracle_limitation: Runs remain pending until a matched actual image/runtime configuration is available. One-image compile admission and historical GNU14.4/OpenCoarrays execution do not prove new GNU16 multi-image behavior.

requirements.title: Unallocated allocatable coarray cobounds are undefined
requirements.source: 8.5.6.2 p3 first sentence, physical PDF122, line10
requirements.definition: An unallocated allocatable coarray has undefined cobounds. This is not a specified integer/array value, an expectation of zero bounds, or a requirement to trap an inquiry.

pending.before-allocation-context: PENDING source/context-only binding of the unallocated state under9.7.1.3. A permitted ALLOCATED inquiry can establish that context but cannot sample or validate undefined cobounds. No empty effect program or LCOBOUND/UCOBOUND/THIS_IMAGE/IMAGE_INDEX probe is generated.
pending.after-deallocation-context: PENDING canonical successful collective deallocation and resulting unallocated-state context. Do not infer cobounds from old allocation values, freed descriptors, memory contents or a failure/trap. Any retained existing context case keeps its original role.

requirements.oracle: Original undefined-state accounting with only defined status/context evidence; there is no result-value oracle for the undefined cobounds.
requirements.oracle_limitation: No negative twin or runtime sampler of undefined state, and no facet-completion credit from source-use inventories, including reviewed ones.

requirements.title: Unallocated coarray use is restricted with specific inquiry exceptions
requirements.source: 8.5.6.2 p3 remaining clauses, physical PDF122, lines10-11
requirements.definition: No part of an unallocated allocatable coarray is referenced or defined, subject to the intrinsic-inquiry permissions of16.1 and each intrinsic's specific requirements. A known declared rank/corank is not permission to call every inquiry.

pending.prohibited-use-source-contrast: PENDING source-only unallocated payload reference/definition contrasts. The valid control requires successful collective allocation and definition before value use, plus ordered segments for remote use. No invalid program is run or required to trap, and no mandatory prose diagnostic policy is invented.
pending.inquiry-exceptions: PENDING finite contract table: ALLOCATED is permitted for the allocatable entity; RANK of a named data object is not a cobound query; LCOBOUND/UCOBOUND/THIS_IMAGE with COARRAY require allocation; IMAGE_INDEX requires an established coarray, which an unallocated coarray is not. Retain DIM/kind/rightmost-part conditions rather than blanket16.1 permission.
pending.unallocated-actual-context: PENDING allowed unallocated actual to a matching ALLOCATABLE coarray dummy under15.5.2.7, with no payload/cobound read. A nonallocatable nonoptional receiver is not a general substitute; association and allocation-state predicates remain separate.

requirements.oracle: Source restrictions and finite permitted-use contexts, not undefined-value outcomes.
requirements.oracle_limitation: Source-only rejection plans need a separately justified policy or actual numbered owner before execution. No capability skip or raw descriptor observation closes this restriction.

requirements.title: Allocated coarray cobounds come from allocation
requirements.definition: An allocated allocatable coarray has the cobounds specified by its allocation, with argument association and the intrinsic interpretation of the final-star upper cobound retaining their canonical rules.

pending.scalar-allocation-cobounds: PENDING actual two-image collective allocation of a scalar corank-two INTEGER coarray with coshape[-1:0,4:*]. After successful status and allocation, expect lower cobounds[-1,4] and upper cobounds[0,4] in that unchanged current team. No payload read is needed for these available properties.
pending.data-bounds-independent: PENDING rank-one data bounds-2:0 with the same corank-two allocation coshape, verifying ordinary bounds separately from cobounds. All active images use the same required allocation/type/bound parameters and matched collective order.
pending.dummy-association-cobounds: PENDING full-interface ALLOCATABLE coarray dummy receiving that allocated actual with the same corank and required parameters. Check actual allocation-derived cobounds, not the declaration colon characters or a nonallocatable dummy's independent explicit coshape.

requirements.oracle: Source-derived small literal cobound vectors on a specified actual image configuration, after state checks and valid collective allocation.
requirements.oracle_limitation: Allocation failure gives no permission to inspect unavailable properties. Do not turn UCOBOUND's current-team-dependent final value into an unconditional stored allocation integer or impose these finite choices on every nonallocatable dummy.

requirements.title: Cobounds do not follow later changes of allocation expression variables
requirements.definition: Subsequent redefinition or undefinition of variables used by the cobound expressions does not change the established allocatable coarray cobounds. This is not a blanket invariance under reallocation, argument reassociation or team changes.

pending.source-redefinition: PENDING allocate collectively from defined lower/upper/final-lower variables-1,0,4, then change those source variables to distinct values and compare available cobounds with the original literal vectors in the same team. No second invocation of the allocation expression serves as the expected result.
pending.source-undefinition: PENDING the same allocated context followed by a complete INTENT(OUT) helper leaving only the source integers undefined. Inquire only the coarray's still-available captured cobounds, then redefine the source integers by literals before reuse. No uninitialized-value read, poisoning or trap.
pending.team-boundary-source-use: PENDING separate5.4.8/11.1.5.2/16.9.216 analysis for team transitions and coarray establishment. Runtime invariance plans keep the team fixed; do not assume that a final-star inquiry ignores current-team image count.

requirements.oracle: Independent retained cobound expectations after defined state establishment, with subsequent source-variable mutations separated from coarray/team operations.
requirements.oracle_limitation: Effects require real coarray execution/configuration and remain pending; no compile-only fallback, reallocation shortcut or unsafe remote/property inquiry.
